integrity: The all-alphabet theorem is supported by the displayed symbolic Laplacian factorization, with independent finite integer determinant and exhaustive tour checks. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Four-letter locally square-free windows only; q >= 3, alphabet labels retained, rotation quotient only; not a theorem about globally square-free circular words or longer windows. A directly plausible 2010 paper on forbidden subsequences was not available in full, so historical priority remains qualified.
title: Exact enumeration of universal cycles for locally square-free four-letter words
